findings_map.source: AGDF MCP interface review of 2026-10-16 (twelve findings)

findings.finding: AGDF domain failures are returned without isError
Worker maps every exception to dispatch_worker_failed (repair runtime / effect_unknown before dispatch)
findings.not_measurable: Call matrix v1 has no input that fails inside the worker after SDK validation (for example the 64 KB command budget); add such a call in a later matrix version.

findings.finding: invalid_input is terminal and sends agent-directed text to the human
agdf_inspect and the command tools leave parameters undocumented
Command rejections return codes without recovery guidance; cockpit errors are undifferentiated
Behavioral instructions live in descriptions and results
findings.partial: Indirect only: the share of instruction payload is not separated from data in v1.

findings.finding: Tools mix effect classes (preview with apply, runtime replacement with recording)
findings.partial: Static annotations only; host permission prompts per call are not measured in v1.

findings.finding: Large responses and a 1 MB cap far above host limits
Per-call worker and provenance hashing cause high latency
Command tools lack outputSchema; dispatch fields are loosely typed
Metadata inconsistencies (capability manifest, idempotentHint, missing titles, handle lifetimes)
findings.partial: The capability manifest and handle-lifetime texts are not compared in v1.
